# Extended image: pi-sandbox with the LLM Wiki extension (heavyweight context).
#
# Build:
#   docker build -f Dockerfile.pi.wiki -t pi-sandbox:wiki .
#
# Run:
#   docker run -it --rm \
#     -v "$PWD/configs/pi-docker-models.json:/root/.pi/agent/models.json" \
#     -v ~/.pi/agent/auth.json:/root/.pi/agent/auth.json \
#     -v ~/.pi/agent/sessions:/root/.pi/agent/sessions \
#     -v "$PWD:/workspace" \
#     pi-sandbox:wiki

FROM pi-sandbox:base

RUN cd /root/.pi/agent/npm \
  && npm install --legacy-peer-deps pi-llm-wiki@latest

# Add the extension to settings.json packages array
RUN node -e "\
  const s = JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/root/.pi/agent/settings.json','utf8')); \
  s.packages.push('npm:pi-llm-wiki'); \
  require('fs').writeFileSync('/root/.pi/agent/settings.json', JSON.stringify(s, null, 2) + '\\n');\
"
